objective: Test whether a minimal event-time ML router can distinguish rejected Bybit fair-value raids from accepted displacements with enough gross distance and accuracy to exceed 24bp costs and 1% sample-day NAV growth without winner concentration.
trader_rule: Freeze the completed one-second mark-index midpoint as external fair value.
Treat an extreme completed last-price displacement beyond that pool as a liquidity raid.
Enter no earlier than the next completed one-second state.
Use one calibrated HGBT to choose fair-value rejection, displacement acceptance or flat.
For rejection, target frozen fair value and stop at 150% further extension.
For acceptance, target 150% extension and stop at frozen fair value.
Never exit because elapsed time reached a fixed limit. An unresolved sample boundary is charged the full adverse structural stop.

data_contract.source: Tardis normalized Bybit derivative_ticker CSV reconstructed from public real-time feeds
data_contract.field_freshness: Decision requires last_price, mark_price and index_price to have each changed within three completed seconds; entry requires last_price to have changed within three completed seconds.

event_contract.threshold: per-symbol 99.5th percentile of absolute completed fair-value gap or last-mark gap learned from fit dates only
event_contract.non_overlap: within-symbol next event starts only after prior structural resolution plus five seconds

model_contract.calibration: one isotonic map fitted only on 2022-07 through 2022-09
model_contract.structure_comparator: one fixed five-feature logistic baseline used only for lift measurement
model_contract.authority: model may choose rejection fade, displacement acceptance or flat only

execution_contract.funding_cashflow: not separately replayed in this short structural fatal screen; 24bp primary reserve is deliberately larger than ordinary taker round-trip fees and the screen cannot become rank eligible without exact funding and BBO reconstruction

promotion_boundary: A survivor remains pre-2024 and non-rank-eligible. It must retain the unchanged event, model and order logic across all remaining pre-2024 evidence, then add exact Bybit BBO, spread, slippage, latency, funding, marked NAV and official sequential 2024-2026 replay.
